name: Central Neurocytoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System

criteria.description: Tumor located predominantly in the lateral ventricles near the foramen of Monro
Presence of uniform round cells with neuronal differentiation and low mitotic activity
Positive staining for synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase (NSE)
MRI showing well-circumscribed intraventricular mass with cystic areas and calcifications

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of typical intraventricular tumor location with characteristic histology and positive neuronal immunohistochemical markers
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of imaging, histopathology, and immunohistochemistry findings.

imaging: MRI showing well-circumscribed intraventricular mass with cystic changes and calcifications
CT scan demonstrating hyperdense intraventricular lesion with calcifications
genetic: No consistent genetic mutations identified; some cases show alterations in chromosomal regions 1p and 19q
Lack of IDH1/2 mutations distinguishes from oligodendrogliomas
other: Histopathology reveals uniform round cells with neuronal differentiation
Immunohistochemistry positive for synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase (NSE), negative for glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)

distinguishingFeatures: Ependymomas often arise from the ventricular lining but show perivascular pseudorosettes histologically
Immunohistochemistry positive for GFAP, unlike central neurocytoma
Typically cortical location rather than intraventricular
Presence of IDH mutations and 1p/19q co-deletion
Histology shows fried-egg appearance with branching capillaries

redFlags: Signs of acute hydrocephalus such as sudden headache and vomiting
New onset seizures in a young adult
references: Louis DN, Perry A, Reifenberger G, et al. The 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System: a summary. Neuro Oncol. 2021;23(8):1231-1251.
Kleihues P, Cavenee WK. WHO Classification of Tumours of the Central Nervous System. 4th ed. IARC; 2016.
